newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Van Ommeren in storage/shipping expansion.
newsitem.headline: Van Ommeren in storage/shipping expansion.

text.p: Shipping and tank storage firm Koninklijke van Ommeren NV said on Thursday it would invest 130 million guilders in expanding its tank storage and shipping operations.
Van Ommeren said it will acquire a 128,000 cubic metre oil distribution terminal in Rotterdam from BP /Texaco joint venture Nerefco.
In the UK, Van Ommeren is to expand its terminal at Barry in South Wales with a new terminal of 42,000 cubic metres capacity, to be fully operational in the first half of 1999.
Van Ommeren has also increased its interest in Brostroms from 38.9 percent to 46.8 percent. Brostroms has a controlling interest in Swedish shipping company United Tankers.

In Singapore, the capacity of the Sakra terminal will be increased by 35,000 cubic metres to 100,000 cubic metres, based on a long-term, 15-year contract for the storage of feedstock for a new chemical plant that will start in July 1998.
In Australia, Van Ommeren said provisional agreement had been reached with Wickland Oil Company on the acquisition of a 70,000 cubic metre oil terminal near Melbourne.
